item.title: [7.0] US economy outstrips forecasts to add 165,000 jobs in October
item.description:
WHAT HAPPENED

In light of stronger-than-anticipated US payroll figures, gold prices dipped significantly as the data suggested a robust labor market. This development heightened expectations for sustained high-interest rates from the Federal Reserve, bolstering the dollar's strength. Spot gold saw a decline of 0.3% to reach $4,074.36 per ounce, while US gold futures fell by 0.9%.

WHY IT MATTERS

Strong US jobs data shifting Federal Reserve rate expectations and driving moves in the dollar and gold represents a material macroeconomic development for global markets.

item.title: [6.2] VFlash: Fast, Accurate Visual Planning via Flash Primitive Decoding
item.description:
WHAT HAPPENED

Models for physical AI tasks, such as robotics and autonomous driving, need not reason solely in language. They can use visual plans--points, bounding boxes, and trajectories--to represent spatial goals and anticipate motion. However, autoregressive vision-language models generate these plans one coordinate token at a time, making richer predictions increasingly costly.

WHY IT MATTERS

Extends vision-language integration for complex real-world reasoning and interaction.
